root_idea.summary: The root primarily centers on friction or rubbing accompanied by heat, burning, and fiery intensity; a separate lexical branch concerns a hip or thigh tendon.
root_idea.development: From rubbing and heat arise meanings involving filing, grinding, burning, scorching, vehement activity, and related figurative extensions. The anatomical branch naming the ḥāriqa tendon is treated as distinct.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form.
Displayed as the Quranic noun حَرِيق.

senses.definition: To burn or scorch something by applying intense heat, including to burn it with fire.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative Form II use. The Quranic contexts include commands or declarations to burn an object or person; the action may carry an intensive or repeated nuance in Classical usage.

senses.definition: To file, abrade, or grind something down with a tool or by rubbing.
senses.usage_conditions: Explicitly reported for the reading or interpretation of لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ in 20:97, where the object is reduced with files rather than burned by flame.

senses.definition: To burn or become burned; to be consumed by fire.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive or quasi-passive Form VIII use describing an object that undergoes burning, as in the Quranic image of a garden becoming burned.

senses.definition: Burning fire; the state or punishment of being burned.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it occurs in the construction عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ, denoting punishment by burning or the burning fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grind or grate the teeth together, producing a grating sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person expressing anger or rage; it may also describe a camel’s canine tooth, with variant contextual explanations for the animal’s state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat something completely or to the uttermost.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal-noun usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be bad-tempered, angry, or evil in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person’s disposition rather than the physical act of burning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A burn, mark, or hole in cloth caused by heat or forceful beating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes damage produced during beating, washing, or whitening, as well as a hole caused by fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spring forth or flash vehemently, especially of lightning; a cloud may be described as flashing intensely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of violent or intense lightning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall off, become scanty, or become unevenly shortened, especially of hair, feathers, or a beard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of hair or feathers falling away piecemeal, and of a beard shorter at the chin than at the sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have the ḥāriqa tendon or hip structure severed or displaced, resulting in an impaired gait.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The affected person may walk on the toes, stand with the body inclined, or become lame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a mark or impression on something by fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative Form II construction focused on the mark left by fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make camels thirsty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of pasture, particularly pasture of the type called ḥamḍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have sexual intercourse in a side-position.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form III construction; the evidence supports the sexual construction without restricting the object’s gender or other class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause burning pain, distress, annoyance, hurt, or affliction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension marked as tropical in the source, used of blows, chafing, fever, hunger, anger, or other causes of suffering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To blame, upbraid, reproach, or detract from someone’s reputation with the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction involving verbal abuse or denunciation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To scorch, shrivel, nip, or blast vegetation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be attributed to heat, cold, wind, or another harmful agent; both transitive and intransitive formulations are attested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To destroy or cause something to perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of burning and consuming.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring or place fire for someone, or to kindle fire upon something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in a request to provide fire on or upon a specified object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thick flour-based food or hot-water preparation made by sprinkling flour into water or fresh milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A humble food associated with hardship or scarcity; it is also known in the plural as حَرَائِق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To burn with hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V expression comparable to burning or smoldering with hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fiery, ardent, or vehement in running, especially of a horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a horse that runs much or intensely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become black, said of silver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or altered-state use of the intransitive Form VIII.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended intransitive result of burning or destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fire, flame, or burning fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage that can denote the fire itself or its flame, including fire invoked in idiomatic and traditional expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A burning sensation or internal heat, including the pain of love, grief, illness, or irritation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be felt in the belly, chest, eye, or heart; the figurative uses are marked as tropical in the source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Chafing or rubbing of the thighs against one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional noun for friction between the thighs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extremely salt or caustic water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water is described as burning the drinker’s throat or affecting camels’ urine because of its salinity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tinder, a burnt rag, or another substance used to catch fire when struck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes remaining burnt cloth and similar fire-catching material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: All-consuming or relentlessly burning, said of fire that spares nothing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjective describing fire’s complete consumption of what it reaches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who spoils, destroys, or consumes everything without sparing anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative application of the all-consuming quality of fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement throwing, casting, or shooting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective applied to the intensity of a throw or shot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who has been burned or who falls into fire and burns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive or resultative nominal use distinct from the Quranic noun’s meaning of burning fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp or cutting as though possessing the quality of burning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an iron point or blade of an arrow, spear, sword, or similar implement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having badly chapped extremities.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use reported for a person’s extremities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side of the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal anatomical use distinct from the ḥāriqa tendon and the sexual construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tendon or joint structure in the hip connecting the thigh and hip region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term has several closely related anatomical explanations; severance or displacement is said to impair walking or cause lameness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fire-throwing ship or a light, fast vessel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the specialized historical sense, the ship carried engines for throwing fire at enemies on sea or river.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Places where meat is fried or charcoal is made.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal plural usage associated with the people of al-Basrah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron implement used for roasting meat, a spit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized interpretation of the word in a poetic context.

cautions: The Quranic Form II occurrence in 20:97 has an explicitly reported alternate interpretation in which the object is filed or abraded with files; the supplied contextual English reflects only the burning interpretation.
The root also contains a distinct anatomical branch centered on حَارِقَة and مَحْرُوق, which is not part of the fire-and-rubbing semantic branch.
